function.name: read_open_word_doc
function.description: Read text or a named section from the currently open Microsoft Word document.

section_hint.description: Optional section heading or keyword, e.g. 'executive summary'.

function.name: create_word_doc
function.description: Draft a new Microsoft Word (.docx) document for user confirmation before saving.

content.description: Full body content of the document.

function.name: edit_word_doc
function.description: Prepare a proposed edit to the open Microsoft Word document selection or named section.

instruction.description: What change or rewrite to make.

section_hint.description: Optional section name if nothing is highlighted.

function.name: open_app_or_site
function.description: Open a Windows application, File Explorer, WhatsApp, Chrome (optional profile), Google, YouTube, drive, or folder.

target.description: App name ('chrome', 'word', 'file manager', 'whatsapp'), drive ('D drive'), or path.

profile.description: Optional Chrome user profile name (e.g., 'Guest' or profile display name).

function.name: close_app
function.description: Stage closing an open desktop application window for user confirmation.

target.description: Window title or application name to close.

function.name: list_windows
function.description: List visible open desktop windows with titles and process names.

function.name: focus_window
function.description: Bring an open window to the foreground by title or process name.

query.description: Partial window title or process name.

function.name: window_control
function.description: Minimize, maximize, or restore an open desktop window.

query.description: Optional partial window title or app name; omit for active window.

function.name: open_terminal
function.description: Open Windows Terminal or PowerShell. Leave path empty unless the user explicitly named a folder or drive.

path.description: Optional existing directory path or drive ('D:\'); omit or pass '' for default.

function.name: navigate_files
function.description: List files in a folder, search files by pattern, or open a path in Explorer.

function.name: google_search
function.description: Search the web and summarize results, or open Google Search directly in Google Chrome.

open_in_browser.description: Set true if the user wants Google opened in Chrome/browser.

function.name: read_active_screen
function.description: Read text from the active window (uses native Windows OCR automatically for VMware).

function.name: inspect_ui_elements
function.description: Inspect up to 50 visible interactive UI controls on the active window (masks passwords).

function.name: memory_save
function.description: Save a personal fact or a user workflow/style preference to local memory.

preference_value.description: Optional preference value, e.g. 'formal and concise'.

function.name: memory_recall
function.description: Search saved personal memories and facts.

query.description: Topic or query to search in local memory.

function.name: memory_delete
function.description: Delete a saved personal memory matching a query.

query.description: Topic or memory description to remove.

function.name: vmware_list_vms
function.description: List running VMware virtual machines via vmrun and resolve guest IPs.

function.name: vmware_run_linux_cmd
function.description: Execute a Linux shell command inside a running VMware VM over key-based SSH.

function.name: run_windows_command
function.description: Stage a Windows CMD command for mandatory user confirmation before execution. Supports captured output or opening a visible Command Prompt window.

command.description: Windows CMD command line to execute.

cwd.description: Optional working directory (e.g. 'Desktop' or full path).

open_visible_cmd.description: True to open a visible cmd.exe window; omit for Smart mode.
